payload.claim: The spec's blanket claim "Line numbers below were read at `61326e45`" is not quite true for that one `CONTEXT.md` citation: at `61326e45` the cited paragraph still held the single-sentence predecessor text, not the two sentences actually being pointed at, which were only written by a later commit that is itself an ancestor of the stated base. Every other line citation in the spec (all inside `saffron/`, `tests/`, and `.saffron/gates/tests.py`) is unaffected, since no non-doc file changed between `61326e45` and the stated base `a013119a`. Harmless and informational only.
